html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · July 1, 2022

On Jun 29, 2022, global digitalization SaaS FreeD (founded 2015; travel-rooted B2C) closed a $15M Series B led by Daiwa ACA APAC Growth LP, with The Musketeers, Chinachem Group, HKSTP CVF, Huike Capital, SOSV Select — 3rd round (Pre-A Oct’17, A Dec’19) — for R&D/hiring and new tech centers in Toronto + Singapore (SEA, Europe, Americas, MENA). Dual teams: core SaaS vs controlled customization; S2B2C (software + supply chain + service). Products: ecom solutions, AI chatbots, automated touchpoints. China Mobile case in CN images — attach on ingest.

— END —
